metaTitle: La Faraona Cigar Factory: Cigars in Ybor City
metaDescription: La Faraona’s Ybor listing is 1515 E 7th Ave. The site also lists 1315 E 7th Ave, a factory lounge, tap beer, and a roller you can book for an event.

publish.hoursNote: The homepage we read does not print shop hours. Call the number on our listing, (978) 648-1422, or check the La Faraona site.

facts: La Faraona Cigar Factory, Ybor City, Tampa. Database address 1515 E 7th Ave, Tampa, FL 33605. Database phone (978) 648-1422.
The website says two locations: 1315 E 7th Ave and 1515 E 7th Ave, Tampa, Fl 33605. It says come into the factory in Ybor City. It says they now offer tap beer and select wines.

The site says we are Cuban and our family has rolled cigars for many years, and that they now live in Tampa. Services named: have a roller at your event, and a cigar rolling experience. It also names the La Faraona Cigar Lounge and collections including Dalá Premium Blend.
No weekly hours were in the homepage text we read.
